name: GeniusYield Arb Bot
description: Run your own market-maker bot that fills GeniusYield SLV orders by arbing against DexHunter and external Cardano DEXes. Non-custodial: you hold the wallet seed.

BASE_ASSET_ID.description: Base asset of the pair you want to trade (e.g. NMKR's assetId)

WALLET_SEED.description: Your bot wallet seed phrase. Treated as a Railway secret — encrypted at rest, masked in logs.

BLOCKFROST_API_KEY.description: Free Blockfrost API key from https://blockfrost.io

MIN_PROFIT_BPS.description: Minimum profit threshold in basis points (50 = 0.5%)

MAX_FILL_BASE.description: Max single-fill size in base asset indivisible units

POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: How often to scan for arb opportunities (milliseconds)
